Ana (eng-platform): Quick async standup for tiny-slice prelaunch (day0).
What I did: wired up slice routing rules for slice-id=slice-tiny-7, updated FF rollout policy, added canary alert dashboards.
Blockers: waiting on canary observability metric breakdown from runtime; one failing warmup unit test (allocator).
Today: watch metrics until 10:30 PT, trigger 1% warmup, attach logs to PR #438.

Devon (eng-releases): saw the test fail earlier, working on a fix for the allocator edge case. ETA ~45m. Ping me if you want to hold rollout.

Mike (eng-runtime): observability exports are live. initial warmup numbers: p50=85ms, p95=420ms; baseline p95 was ~380ms. Not a hard blocker but monitoring. Deployed a small kv-eviction logging hotfix; tailing logs now.

Sophia (product): product team ok with 1% start. Can we gate auto-escalation at 5% if p95 > 500ms? CS will be on standby.

Jules (support): We're prepped. If you need rollback, tell us the exact key + environment.

Ana (eng-platform): Toggle plan: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% after 1h if signals stable. Manual rollback thresholds: p95 > 600ms OR error-rate spike > 0.5%.

DeployBot: [automated] feature-flag slice-tiny-7 set to rollout 1% by Ana at 3323456900

Devon (eng-releases): PR #438 ready for review. @Mike can you take a quick look at lines ~72-85 (allocator change)? small diff.

Mike (eng-runtime): reviewing now. looks safe; left one inline about a nil-check.

Ana (eng-platform): I'm starting the warmup now. trigger command:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/rollout" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"slice-tiny-7","pct":1}'
```

Mike (eng-runtime): logs show warmup requests flowing. kv hit-rate improving; some cold-start traces but not widespread.

DeployBot: [metrics] warmup: 1% -> p50 82ms, p95 410ms, errors 0.03% (3323457030)

Ana (eng-platform): no human-visible regressions in canary logs. continuing to watch for 30m. if anyone sees anomalies ping here or @oncall.

Sophia (product): noted. I'll update the stakeholder doc and set an internal slack alert channel.

Jules (support): standing by for rollback key. shipping note to CS: "If users report latency >2s, escalate to eng-platform."

Devon (eng-releases): merging PR after Mike's nil-check fix.

Mike (eng-runtime): merged. also pushed a Sentry tag to group warmup traces for easier triage.

DeployBot: [action] flag slice-tiny-7 bumped to 5% (manual) by Ana at 3323458000

Ana (eng-platform): moving to 5% per plan. continuing to monitor. next checkpoint 10:30 PT.

End
